dogecoin.text: I'm driving thru a small rural town and I see written in the dust on the back of a delivery truck "buy dogecoin"

My buddy, who doesn't do social media, told me he bought "dogecoin stock" in his robinhood account. 

I asked him why.

He said because it's going up.

I told him to move it out of RH to his crypto wallet.

He asked, what's a crypto wallet? https://t.co/RrzNEl0Xbu
If #dogecoin is a scam then #Bitcoin is a scam. Choose your words carefully, HODLers.
